A '''battle''' took place on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. A group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] had been bringing captive Jedi, especially younglings, to the world, so that they could hunt them for sport. A small team of these fugitives, led by [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]], evaded the hunters by staying hidden and out of combat. However, when [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was brought to the moon, she advocated a more aggressive stance, and after Kalifa was killed, she took command of the remaining Jedi. Eventually, they destroyed a slave ship and freed its sole prisoner, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], capturing a Trandoshan in the process.

The Wookiee later attempted to construct a transmitter from the wreckage, but the two surviving younglings, [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]] decided that it wouldn't work and persuaded Tano and Chewbacca into attacking the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|floating fortress]] of the hunters. They first tricked their prisoner into calling a hover pod, then hijacked the vehicle when it arrived. When they reached the fortress, they had nearly been overpowered by the guards, but the arrival of Wookiee reinforcements led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]]—who had been informed by Chewbacca's makeshift transmitter—and bounty hunters turned the tide of the battle.

==The battle==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]<ref name="PLEG" /> [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] were actively capturing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], mostly [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], so that they could hunt them. During the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]], one of them [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was brought to [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]] on the moon [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], along with several other captives. Upon arriving at the location, the prisoners were released, and the hunters opened fire. Tano evaded the blasts and escaped into the forest, where she met a team of Jedi, who banded together to survive.<ref name="PL" />

The [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], led by [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]], explained her that they evaded conflict with the hunters, giving up the Jedi ways of life.<ref name="PL" /> When the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]<ref name="tano-db">{{DB|character|ahsokatano|Tano, Ahsoka}}</ref> observed two of her fellow prisoners getting [[Death/Legends|killed]] without them doing anything, she furiously questioned their allegiance, prompting Kalifa to explain the situation.<ref name="PL" />
